tools.name: get_active_ghost_list
tools.title: Get Active Ghost List
tools.description: Get current active ghost list suitable for ghost_name parameter. Please use this tool before using sakurascript tool.

tools.name: get_status
tools.title: Get Ghost Status
tools.description: Get current status of a ghost as comma separated flags (same as SSTP EXECUTE GetStatus). Empty means idle. Flags: talking, choosing, minimizing, changing, induction, passive, timecritical, nouserbreak, online, opening(...), balloon(...). Sending SakuraScript while talking / choosing / timecritical / opening may interrupt the ghost or be rejected.

ghost_name.description: Optional: target ghost name or full path of its root folder

tools.name: get_expression_table
tools.title: Get Surface Table
tools.description: Get list of ghost expressions in markdown tabular form. Suitable for use with SakuraScript \s[] tag. Please use this tool before using sakurascript tool.

ghost_name.description: Target ghost name or full path of its root folder

tools.name: get_property
tools.title: Get Property System
tools.description: Get Ukagaka property system value : for detail please see https://ssp.shillest.net/ukadoc/manual/list_propertysystem.html

ghost_name.description: Optional: target ghost name or full path of its root folder

tools.name: get_log
tools.title: Get Log
tools.description: Get SSP log entries, oldest first. One entry per line: "#id time [type] name : text" (continuation lines of multi-line text start with a tab). log_type: error (errors/warnings of SSP and ghosts, including sakurascript strict errors), script (played SakuraScripts), network, update, status. Use since_id with the largest id you have seen to get only new entries.

log_type.description: Optional: error (default) / script / network / update / status

ghost_name.description: Optional: only entries of this ghost (ghost name or full path of its root folder)

since_id.description: Optional: only entries with id greater than this

max_count.description: Optional: maximum number of newest entries to return

tools.name: sakurascript
tools.title: Send SakuraScript
tools.description: Send Ukagaka SakuraScript to a ghost (character). Please use get_active_ghost_list , get_expression_table tools first to obtain detailed information.

ghost_name.description: Optional: send target ghost name or full path of its root folder

strict.description: Optional: if true, record script errors (unknown surface/balloon/animation/command) to the error log during playback. Read them with get_log tool (log_type=error, since_id=value returned by this tool).

tools.name: raise_event
tools.title: Raise SHIORI Event
tools.description: Send a SHIORI event to a ghost (same as SSTP NOTIFY with Event header) and play the script it returns. The returned script is included in the result. Useful to try random talks (OnAiTalk) or reactions (OnMouseDoubleClick etc.).

references.description: Optional: Reference0, Reference1, ... of the event

ghost_name.description: Optional: target ghost name or full path of its root folder

strict.description: Optional: if true, record script errors of the returned script to the error log during playback (same as sakurascript tool).

tools.name: reload
tools.title: Reload Ghost
tools.description: Reload ghost / shiori (dictionaries) / shell / balloon / makoto / descript of a ghost, for example after editing its files. Errors while loading are recorded to the error log; check them with get_log tool.

target.description: What to reload: ghost / shiori / shell / balloon / makoto / descript

ghost_name.description: Optional: target ghost name or full path of its root folder

tools.name: dump_surface
tools.title: Dump Surface Image
tools.description: Get an image (PNG with transparency) of a ghost's character. Without surface, captures what is currently shown on the screen: use it to check the result of sakurascript tool. With surface, renders that surface ID alone in its initial state regardless of the screen. One image per call.

scope.description: Optional: character scope (0 = \0 main character, 1 = \1 partner, ...). Default 0

surface.description: Optional: surface ID to render. If omitted, the surface currently shown on the screen is captured as is

ghost_name.description: Optional: target ghost name or full path of its root folder

tools.name: dump_balloon
tools.title: Dump Balloon Image
tools.description: Get an image (PNG with transparency) of the balloon (speech bubble) of a character as last drawn. While the ghost is still talking the text may be partially drawn; wait until get_status no longer reports talking.

scope.description: Optional: character scope whose balloon is captured (0 = \0, 1 = \1, ...). Default 0

ghost_name.description: Optional: target ghost name or full path of its root folder
